name: Orchestrate Refinement
description: Fan-out document processing with cross-validation and corrective loops. Intellectual mode — no worktrees. Use for parallel story refinement across an epic.

name: Orchestrate Implementation
description: Parallel story implementation with git worktree isolation + code review + quality gates + merge gate. Full implementation mode.

name: Orchestrate Full Pipeline
description: End-to-end pipeline: intellectual refinement → implementation → validation in a single composed flow.

name: Cleanup and Recovery
description: Cleanup orphaned worktrees and recover from interrupted orchestration pipelines. Handles stale branches and uncommitted work.

name: Execution Status
description: View current orchestration state — sub-agent progress and pending actions. Invoked from agent menu.
